strings.تبي تجدّد البيت لكن أرضيتك وأبوابك ما زا: You want to renovate the house, but your floor and doors still fit you? You can plan on renovating the finishes while retaining items that are proven to be suitable for continuation, instead of considering changing everything as the starting point. The decision needs to examine the state of the asset and determine how new finishes meet it. With Almusaileem Paints & Decor in Kuwait, discuss renovating walls and interior details within the company’s services, supplying with execution and an agreed scope.

strings.حدّد ما تريد الاحتفاظ به أولًا: Decide what you want to keep first.
strings.اكتب قائمة بالعناصر التي تحبها أو لا ترغ: Make a list of items you like or don’t want to change: floor color, door shape, fixed cabinets, or part of the entrance decor. Then separate the desire from the technical condition; admiring the shape doesn’t prove the element’s integrity, and providing a finish alone doesn’t mean it’s invalid. Any damage, movement, or moisture effect calls for evaluation before inserting the item into your retention plan.
strings.لا تختَر الكسوة أو لون الجدار بمعزل عن ه: Don’t choose a cladding or wall color apart from this list. A reference image may display a different floor, a higher ceiling and other lighting; use it to illustrate taste, then adjust the details to your home. This way, the comparison between the current design and the proposal will be related to the real place.
strings.نقاط التقاء القديم والجديد تستحق الانتبا: Old and new points of convergence deserve attention.
strings.في التجديد الجزئي، اسأل عن نهاية التشطيب: In partial renovation, ask about the finishing end at the door frame, the cabinet and the corner of the wall. Do you need to unscrew a piece and return it? Will the edge remain visible? And how does the addition of cladding fit with the movement of the door and furniture? These points fall back on the actual sizes before the implementation is adopted, and it is not enough to choose a close color to hide the difference of details.
strings.إذا احتاج التصميم تغيير فتحة أو إزالة جز: If the design needs to change an opening or remove a part of the building, separate it from the request for decoration and call on the qualified specialist.
strings.إلى ضرورة التصميم المهني للأعمال الإنشائ: The need for professional design of construction works and clarification of project items. Do not assume that a small modification in the image is structurally simple.

strings.ضع عينات الألوان والخامات بجانب الأرضية: Place the samples of colors and materials next to the floor and door in the same room. Check them during the day and with the lighting you use at night, then adopt a limited set that connects the place together. You can choose a distinctive background for the lounge and keep the rest of the walls quiet, or unite the colors of the corridors with the rooms without copying details in each space.

strings.اختيار وسائل الحماية والتنظيف يراعي نوع: The choice of protection and cleaning methods takes into account the type of finishing and the instructions for its material; do not try strong adhesives or detergents at random on a surface that you want to maintain. If damage is detected under the old finishing, the decision on that part is stopped until it is evaluated and the appropriate procedure is adopted.
strings.اربط الميزانية بحدود واضحة: Set a budget with clear boundaries.
strings.اطلب فصل الأعمال الأساسية عن الإضافات ال: Ask to separate the core business from the optional add-ons, and specify what goes into the price and what stays out of range. Retaining some items may reduce the replacement business, but it does not automatically guarantee a lower cost; sometimes its protection and handling require special processing. A useful comparison is between offers for identical items, specifying the material and the mechanism for adopting changes.
